sampling_space_description: A person-level sampling space for a representative sample of the United States population, spanning demographic, geographic, cultural, educational, economic, political, religious, occupational, personality, hobby, habit, and public-opinion differences. Proportions supplied in the input are retained where categories are usable as separate measures. Some reported survey interests and party affiliations overlap, and some supplied figures do not sum to 100%; those measures are represented separately or include a residual category rather than being treated as mutually exclusive. Where the input gives no national proportions, modeled proportions are explicitly illustrative rather than census estimates.
